dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: If you're asking whether it's a comfortable place to stay, I mean, sure. Of course it is.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: But um... I couldn't really see myself living here for the long term. Sorry.

choices.text: Is there something wrong with the place?

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: No, nothing's wrong at all, everything's great. Very charming.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: It's just that I'm more used to camping out in the wilds.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: I'm sure you know by now — back where I'm from, not a day goes by without something to watch out for.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: Like giant machines running around all over the place, or hostile tribes that always seem to have it out for you, or evil machines bent on global extinction...

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: To go from a life like that to something so safe... It'll take me some time to adjust, that's all.

choices.text: You want to go on an adventure?

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: Yes! Don't get me wrong, this is a nice place, but I need to get out. If I stick around here too long, my bowstring's gonna snap.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: Next time we head out, I want you to give me the full story on these Ruin Guards I hear you talking about.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: They sound like my kind of prey. Aim for the glowing part, right?

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: That, plus after you defeat them, you can salvage their components...

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: Strange components, sure, and probably not the kind that I could use to modify my gear. Still, they've gotta have their uses, I guess?
